1070|bd6c9aff.name: Deputy Feldon
1070|bd6c9aff.text: You'll find the town of Lakeshire yonder, across the bridge. But you'll not find it a peaceful place. If you're here for adventure, lad, then mark me--you've found it!

11050|402e026a.name: Trianna
11050|402e026a.text: My education is ongoing, and your knowledge surpasses mine. If you wish to learn more you must speak to Me'lynn. She will guide you.

11866|f3b1497b.name: Ilyenia Moonfire
11866|f3b1497b.text: The grace with which I fight is not something I can teach you, but I can teach you the use of various weapons.

1571|c5ceacbe.name: Shellei Brondir
1571|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1992|05f55f8a.name: Tarindrella
1992|05f55f8a.text: Only in Nature do we find purity.

2079|26ba7149.name: Conservator Ilthalaine
2079|26ba7149.text: Ah, the beauty of Shadowglen never ceases to delight my senses!

2080|ac9bd966.name: Denalan
2080|ac9bd966.text: The creation of Teldrassil was a grand achievement, but now the world must shift to regain its balance.

2082|7bfda406.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
2082|7bfda406.text: The flora and fauna of Shadowglen is a testament to our talents at working with nature.  It is an honor to bear witness to our grand achievement.

2367|c2467ddc.name: Donald Rabonne
2367|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

2432|c5ceacbe.name: Darla Harris
2432|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

256734|edaae191.name: Daniel Stitchsong
256734|edaae191.text: Hello there! I've got the finest leathers this side of Stormwind. Interested?

256735|8db10840.name: Mivin Shadowweave
256735|8db10840.text: <Mivin gestures toward his wares and back at you again with a smile, but says nothing.>

258572|cad23935.name: Dani'ill
258572|cad23935.text: Many of the supplies that tradesmen need can be found in the world. For those that cannot, I provide a limited selection for fair price.

267330|0371bf6f.name: Nawka Wildsong
267330|0371bf6f.text: Care to learn how to gather leather from slain beasts? Or do you need some new tools?

2980|e775a01e.name: Grull Hawkwind
2980|e775a01e.text: Greetings, $N, and welcome to Camp Narache. News of your arrival spread quickly among the tribe.

2993|f7a5deb4.name: Baine Bloodhoof
2993|f7a5deb4.text: The land has been good to our people, $c. We must be thankful for our good fortune.

3060|7b785024.name: Gart Mistrunner
3060|7b785024.text: Many are the paths of the Earth Mother.  May your ancestors watch over you $c.

3061|3f898c12.name: Lanka Farshot
3061|3f898c12.text: Do you prefer guns or bows?

3062|996eca9b.name: Meela Dawnstrider
3062|996eca9b.text: May the spirits be with you.

3442|c0ad1190.name: Sputtervalve
3442|c0ad1190.text: Lots to do, lots to do! The Union's given us deadlines and they're not the sort you want to miss!

3446|36457281.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
3446|36457281.text:
Yes yes yes!  You're just the $r I'm looking for!

Sit!  We have much to discuss!!

344|d18fd3a5.name: Magistrate Solomon
344|d18fd3a5.text: Who is this $c who goes before the Court of Lakshire in the Kingdom of Stormwind?  State your business within this township, $R.  The orc threat to the Kingdom is far too great to squander time in idle conversation.

3567|b4a4b0ca.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
3567|b4a4b0ca.text: Well met, $N. It is good to see that rogues like yourself are taking an active part in protecting the groves.

3571|04612768.name: Dolanaar Sentinel
3571|04612768.text: Malorne somehow manages to pick the most delicate herbs without damaging them.  Certainly he is the one you should learn from.  He lives just east of the Inn in Dolanaar.

3571|1b57b791.name: Dolanaar Sentinel
3571|1b57b791.text: You seek a $c?  I believe Jannok would fit that description.  Why don't you go talk to him over at the Inn in Dolanaar.

3571|2a249ced.name: Dolanaar Sentinel
3571|2a249ced.text: You will find numerous trainers around Dolanaar with ages of experience with which to tutor you.  Which would you have me point you to?

3571|2bd86f46.name: Dolanaar Sentinel
3571|2bd86f46.text: While Cyndra is not bubbly like her potions, her kind manner is suitable for teaching her trade.  You can find her just east of the Inn in Dolanaar.

3571|497f7ea2.name: Dolanaar Sentinel
3571|497f7ea2.text: There are many places that you might visit in Teldrassil.  Tell me what you seek.

3571|d9044b82.name: Dolanaar Sentinel
3571|d9044b82.text: A $c?  I'm not in the habit of referring people to those types, but I believe Jannok would be the one you're looking for.  You will find him at the Inn in Dolanaar.

3571|f844e66a.name: Dolanaar Sentinel
3571|f844e66a.text: The path of those who undertake a profession is long and rewarding.  Which path do you choose to walk?

3594|2ae1d72b.name: Frahun Shadewhisper
3594|2ae1d72b.text: Greetings young $c. What do you seek?

3599|bf230b1e.name: Jannok Breezesong
3599|bf230b1e.text:
Like a cat dragged in from the rain, you scratch and claw, then do it all over again... I'll be back for more...

Oh, I didn't see you enter, $N! What can I do for you?

3603|cc3066f3.name: Cyndra Kindwhisper
3603|cc3066f3.text: Well done! Your understanding of potions is coming along nicely.

3603|efe4f00d.name: Cyndra Kindwhisper
3603|efe4f00d.text: The druids say that it is only a matter of time until nature itself drives the Horde from Kalimdor. Yet corruption continues to spread throughout our lands, even here on Teldrassil.

3838|43c9021b.name: Vesprystus
3838|43c9021b.text: To maintain our link to the mainland, we have hippogryphs constantly flying between Rut'theran Village and Darkshore.

3841|ab4871bb.name: Caylais Moonfeather
3841|ab4871bb.text: The Hippogryph is a noble beast, proud and swift.  They are an honor to train, and can quickly take their rider a great distance.

4159|8afd918f.name: Me'lynn
4159|8afd918f.text: You have done well, traveler. I am proud to call you my student!

4262|ce424d00.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|ce424d00.text: Of all the wondrous places within Darnassus, which would you have me direct you to?

4262|e07232c6.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|e07232c6.text: Here among the craftsmen of Darnassus, there is a millenium of knowledge for the benefit of your chosen craft.  Now tell me, which craft do you find the most intriguing?

4262|e74436e4.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|e74436e4.text: With the garments that Me'Lynn tailors, one might think that her needle was blessed by Elune herself.  Unless your needle is so blessed, you best pay her a visit and listen to her teachings.  You can find her in The Craftsmen's Terrace in northeastern Darnassus.

4267|c5ceacbe.name: Daelyshia
4267|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

5496|86b6c1ef.name: Sandahl
5496|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

5520|721fd095.name: Spackle Thornberry
5520|721fd095.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

6094|a28d29e1.name: Byancie
6094|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

6286|f842f7e5.name: Zarrin
6286|f842f7e5.text: Hello, $N. If you'd like to learn a thing or two about cooking, please visit me at any time.

6736|41276936.name: Innkeeper Keldamyr
6736|41276936.text: Your body looks worn and your spirit weary. Rest yourself beneath our roof and allow Elune to guide your dreams.

6747|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Kauth
6747|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

116-progress.name: Barkeep Daniels
116-progress.text: I need you to pick up a keg of Thunderbrew Lager from Grimbooze Thunderbrew in the Westfall hills, a cask of Merlot from Stormwind, a bottle of Moonshine from Darkshire and a skin of Sweet Rum from Goldshire.  Bring those back to me and I will see to it you are rewarded.
116-progress.title: Dry Times

121-complete.name: Magistrate Solomon
121-complete.text:
Thank you for your time, $c.  For your service to Lakeshire and Stormwind I reward you with these coins.

Now if you'll excuse me, I find this correspondence somewhat of a mystery.  Something is amiss in our Kingdom.  I fear this is the beginning of conflict, not the end.
121-complete.title: Messenger to Stormwind

121-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
121-progress.text: Did the General send news?  Are reinforcements on the way?
121-progress.title: Messenger to Stormwind

129-complete.name: Guard Parker
129-complete.text: Thanks, I could really use the meal.  Guarding Lakeshire from the orcs and gnolls is tough work!
129-complete.title: A Free Lunch

129-progress.name: Guard Parker
129-progress.text: Darcy sent me a lunch, did she?  Such a kind heart she has.  Well...let's have it!
129-progress.title: A Free Lunch

130-accept.name: Guard Parker
130-accept.text:
Before you go back to Darcy, can you bring her some flowers for me?  You can get them at the herbalist shop back in Lakeshire, at the west end of town.

But when you get the flowers...don't tell the herbalist, Martie, whom they're from, or whom they're for...
130-accept.title: Visit the Herbalist

135-complete.name: Master Mathias Shaw
135-complete.text: This matter might be more complex than Stoutmantle realizes.
135-complete.title: The Defias Brotherhood

135-progress.name: Master Mathias Shaw
135-progress.text: What business do you have with me?  I am a very busy man. . .
135-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

141-accept.name: Master Mathias Shaw
141-accept.text:
The Stonemasons' Guild was run by a man named Edwin VanCleef.  VanCleef was responsible for rebuilding Stormwind after the orcs razed it in the First War.  Apparently, VanCleef and his men were unhappy with their treatment by the King after the reconstruction was complete.  That just might explain a thing or two.

I have written a more detailed account for your Master in Westfall.  Take this to him at once!
141-accept.title: The Defias Brotherhood

143-accept.name: Magistrate Solomon
143-accept.text:
Something odd is afoot with the Stormwind Army.  They should have been here in force by now.  Time is a luxury we don't have, however.  I will not stand by and watch the people of Lakeshire give their lives without trying to enlist more help.  I've heard word of a people's militia forming in Westfall.

Take this plea to their leader, Gryan Stoutmantle.  Perhaps Stoutmantle's men can lend some support here until the King sends reserves.
143-accept.title: Messenger to Westfall

1581-accept.name: Syral Bladeleaf
1581-accept.text:
Our herb and alchemy shop is booming, but my husband spends so much time mixing potions that we never have time for each other.

Can you help us?

If you can bring me a supply of pre-made elixirs, then I would be happy to trade with you.  I have some rare herbs that you might find useful.
1581-accept.title: Elixirs for the Bladeleafs

1656-accept.name: Antur Fallow
1656-accept.text:
$N, please, I beg of you, can you help me? I have not finished my tasks here on the Mesa--I'm in the middle of my Rite of Strength--and my father asked me to deliver these furs to the inn in Bloodhoof.

I'm far from rested enough to complete both my rite and this task for my father. Would you mind going on for me?

The inn is pleasant and a perfect place to rest during your long travels. I'm sure you'll agree once you see it.
1656-accept.title: A Task Unfinished

1656-complete.name: Innkeeper Kauth
1656-complete.text:
Ah, the furs I was expecting. Thank you.

These came faster than I had expected. They will make good blankets for anyone who wishes to stay here.

Please feel free to stay as long as you like. My inn is always open and all of our people are welcome here. And don't underestimate a good night's rest, it can make a great difference while you're out traveling.
1656-complete.title: A Task Unfinished

1656-progress.name: Innkeeper Kauth
1656-progress.text:
Yes, young one? What can Kauth do for you?

The journey here from the Mesa can be a tremendous burden for some, but a welcome sight for others. Which is it for you, I wonder?
1656-progress.title: A Task Unfinished

1738-complete.name: Gakin the Darkbinder
1738-complete.text:
Yes, I can tell this will do nicely, let me just work with it for a moment...

Takar is a resourceful fellow to have around, isn't he? If only I could persuade him to move back to civilization.
1738-complete.title: Heartswood

1739-accept.name: Gakin the Darkbinder
1739-accept.text:
Using the heartswood core, you will be able to cast a spell at the summoning circle in the crypt below to open a portal for the succubus to pass through.

Be careful, $N, succubi have overrun even the strongest of minds.

Once you have bested and returned it to the void, return to me and I will show you how to call and control it.
1739-accept.title: The Binding

1739-complete.name: Gakin the Darkbinder
1739-complete.text:
Well done, well done, $N. I see we've done right in deciding to train you. Your performance certainly does not disappoint.

I've no qualms in showing you the way to control your newly bound succubus. Observe carefully.
1739-complete.title: The Binding

1739-progress.name: Gakin the Darkbinder
1739-progress.text: Sometimes I wonder if Surena was not a succubus in disguise, sent to warp and twist my mind... Ha! I give her too much credit, I think.
1739-progress.title: The Binding

2159-accept.name: Porthannius
2159-accept.text:
Greetings, young $c.  Can you offer me aid?  I have a package of herbs that I must deliver to the town of Dolanaar.  But I still have business with the druids of Shadowglen and cannot yet leave.

Can you deliver this package for me?  It must be sent to Innkeeper Keldamyr, at the Dolanaar inn.  It lies along the road, to the south.
2159-accept.title: Dolanaar Delivery

2159-complete.name: Innkeeper Keldamyr
2159-complete.text:
Ah yes, the delivery of herbs from Shadowglen.  It is a shame Porthannius could not bring it himself, for we have much to discuss, he and I.  But I am glad to get the herbs nonetheless, and I am glad you came.

While you are here, please, rest yourself.  Heroes must keep their strength and spirits high, and must find rest and solace whenever they may.  For to neglect one's peace of body and mind is a sure path to failure.

So... rest.
2159-complete.title: Dolanaar Delivery

2159-progress.name: Innkeeper Keldamyr
2159-progress.text: How might I be of service to you, young one?  Are you here to rest in the inn?  Do you require a hearthstone?
2159-progress.title: Dolanaar Delivery

2438-accept.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
2438-accept.text:
I was once given an emerald dreamcatcher from Gaerolas Talvethen, the warden of the druids in the Ban'ethil Barrow Den. This powerful amulet is able to siphon energy from the Emerald Dream, bestowing luck upon those who carry it.

Sadly, I have not been able to retrieve it from my dresser in Starbreeze Village... Although Starbreeze was once a tranquil place, it has now succumbed to the corruption of the furbolg that reside there.

Perhaps you would be willing to recover my dreamcatcher, $c?
2438-accept.title: The Emerald Dreamcatcher

2438-complete.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
2438-complete.text: My emerald dreamcatcher is of great importance to me. It is a gift only given to few. Thank you for returning it, $N.
2438-complete.title: The Emerald Dreamcatcher

2438-progress.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
2438-progress.text:
Please move swiftly. I can only hope that my emerald dreamcatcher has been unharmed by the furbolg.

Have you recovered it yet, $N?
2438-progress.title: The Emerald Dreamcatcher

2459-accept.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
2459-accept.text:
The emerald... It is missing! My dreamcatcher has been damaged!

There is a band of Gnarlpine mystics located to the north of Starbreeze. I have heard reports that their leader, Ferocitas the Dream Eater has been wearing a necklace that glows green in the night. Now seeing my dreamcatcher, I am sure that he has stolen my emerald... He would never realize that its power is useless to him.

Find this missing jewel, $N. And, while you're there, clear out some of the corrupted mystics as well.
2459-accept.title: Ferocitas the Dream Eater

2459-complete.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
2459-complete.text: Now I can repair my dreamcatcher.  Thank you, $N.
2459-complete.title: Ferocitas the Dream Eater

2459-progress.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
2459-progress.text: Ferocitas and the Gnarlpine mystics must return what is mine.  Please retrieve the emerald so that I may repair my emerald dreamcatcher.
2459-progress.title: Ferocitas the Dream Eater

246-progress.name: Deputy Feldon
246-progress.text: Excuse me, $N, but we have a lot to keep our hands tied here.  If you have nothing to report, then I must put my mind to other matters.
246-progress.title: Assessing the Threat

3092-accept.name: Grull Hawkwind
3092-accept.text: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, $N. I believe she was sent by the $c trainer Lanka. If this note is from Lanka, I wouldn't take long in reading it's contents.
3092-accept.title: Etched Note

3092-complete.name: Lanka Farshot
3092-complete.text:
And it is my job to make sure you are prepared by teaching you the basics of our profession--how to tame your pet, how to fire your rifle, and many other skills that will become necessary.

Hunters are a strong part of our tradition and history, $N. You would do well to remember how important you are to the tribe. You will be respected and revered if you serve our people well.
3092-complete.title: Etched Note

3092-progress.name: Lanka Farshot
3092-progress.text:
Welcome to Camp Narache, $N. I hear good things about you. Your bloodline is strong, and many of the elders consider you skilled already. But that we will test.

The plains of Mulgore will be your home for sometime--you should do your best to learn it very well. One day you will travel to unfamiliar lands to master greater skills. You must be ready.
3092-progress.title: Etched Note

3118-accept.name: Conservator Ilthalaine
3118-accept.text: This sigil was given to me by a messenger from our $c trainer, Frahun. It seems Frahun would have words with you when you have a moment. Read it and bring it to him afterwards.
3118-accept.title: Encrypted Sigil

3118-complete.name: Frahun Shadewhisper
3118-complete.text:
Until then, know that our kind are needed more than ever in this tenuous time. Peace with the other races can fail at any moment, and there is much talk about members of the Horde looking to sow even greater seeds of distrust. Remember that.

As you gain in power and feel more prepared, come back to me here and I will see about getting you some training. It's important that you know how to handle your weapon of choice, among other things.
3118-complete.title: Encrypted Sigil

3118-progress.name: Frahun Shadewhisper
3118-progress.text:
Hello, $N. I'm glad you found me. I was thinking that perhaps you got lost on the way here.

Nothing really new has happened in Shadowglen since I sent you my sigil, but I'll leave all the information gathering to you. Speak to the rest of the people around Aldrassil if you'd like.
3118-progress.title: Encrypted Sigil

3376-accept.name: Brave Windfeather
3376-accept.text:
$N - I have heard of you, newcomer.  Perhaps it is you that will help us, where others have failed.

We $r have carved a home out of this land, but not without a cost.  The Bristleback quilboars of Brambleblade Ravine, led by Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle, have made our lives difficult with their continued war against us.  I charge you to bring me the chief's head!

He will be found in the ravine to the east in their makeshift village.
3376-accept.title: Break Sharptusk!

3376-complete.name: Brave Windfeather
3376-complete.text:
Justice has been served on this day by your swift actions, $N.  Let this deed serve as a warning to all who would threaten our home.

You have earned this reward to help you on your sojourn, young $c.
3376-complete.title: Break Sharptusk!

3376-progress.name: Brave Windfeather
3376-progress.text:
Sharptusk will trouble us no more once you have brought me proof of his death.  It is his head that I seek, $N.

We $r live for the hunt, and there is no greater hunt than against one that is cunning enough to perhaps hunt us back.  If you are successful in this task, young one, you will start to learn what I mean.
3376-progress.title: Break Sharptusk!

3519-accept.name: Iverron
3519-accept.text:
Ughhh... I was bitten very badly by a spider named Githyiss the Vile while exploring the spider cave very close to here. I am sure I have been seriously poisoned; you must help me.

Please tell Dirania Silvershine. She will be able to help me.

Hurry... I'm so dizzy...
3519-accept.title: A Friend in Need

3519-complete.name: Dirania Silvershine
3519-complete.text: Oh dear; I was wondering why I hadn't seen Iverron yet today. And I've always warned him about those spiders...
3519-complete.title: A Friend in Need

3521-accept.name: Dirania Silvershine
3521-accept.text:
We may be able to help Iverron, as I know of an antidote that should help with the poison. It requires some ingredients, though, before I can make it.

I'll need Hyacinth mushrooms. You can find these growing under trees, or you may collect them from the grell south of here; they seem to have taken a liking to them. I'll also need Moonpetal lilies, which only grow around watery pools.

The last ingredient may prove the most difficult. From the very spiders that poisoned Iverron, collect Webwood ichor.
3521-accept.title: Iverron's Antidote

3521-complete.name: Dirania Silvershine
3521-complete.text:
Thank Elune that you have gathered these ingredients so quickly!

In just a moment, I will have the antidote prepared.
3521-complete.title: Iverron's Antidote

3521-progress.name: Dirania Silvershine
3521-progress.text: Please, collect the ingredients, $N. Iverron needs our help.
3521-progress.title: Iverron's Antidote

3522-accept.name: Dirania Silvershine
3522-accept.text:
The antidote is ready, $N. Please see that Iverron drinks it.

There is something that you should know -- the antidote -- it will only remain viable for 5 minutes. You must get it to him in time.

Speed be with you, $N.
3522-accept.title: Iverron's Antidote

3522-complete.name: Iverron
3522-complete.text:
What is this, $N?

Oh, I knew Dirania would be able to help me!

<Iverron drinks the antidote.>

I'm always getting into trouble and Dirania, well, she always manages to help me out of it.

I am feeling much better, but I think I will sit here for a while longer, until I feel completely better. Well, that, and I was hoping you'd clear a path for me through those vicious Webwood spiders...
3522-complete.title: Iverron's Antidote

3522-progress.name: Iverron
3522-progress.text: Oh... $N, I'm so glad you have returned.
3522-progress.title: Iverron's Antidote

4161-accept.name: Zarrin
4161-accept.text:
Long ago, the night elves were called the kaldorei, a name that means "children of the stars." Learning of the past is an important step in your path as a $c, $N, so listen well to what I have to tell you.

The kaldorei have always taken much pride in their harmonious relationship with nature. This means that we only take from nature what is necessary, and that we return in kind. This balance has afforded us much, $N.

Go out and collect seven small spider legs -- no more than that, and return to me.
4161-accept.title: Recipe of the Kaldorei

4161-complete.name: Zarrin
4161-complete.text: Always remember what I have shown you today, $N. You are part of the balance that the night elves strive to keep intact, even during troublesome times.
4161-complete.title: Recipe of the Kaldorei

4161-progress.name: Zarrin
4161-progress.text: Remember the balance, $N. I wish you to develop an understanding and a strong empathy for the living forests.
4161-progress.title: Recipe of the Kaldorei

4495-accept.name: Dirania Silvershine
4495-accept.text:
A friend of mine named Iverron usually visits me at the same time every day. The strange thing is that he hasn't been by today at all -- he's several hours late, in fact.

I admit, I am a little worried, $N. Iverron spends a lot of time over by the cave to the north, and I'm sure you know how dangerous it is there -- spiders, everywhere!

If you happen to be going that way, though, will you keep an eye out for him?
4495-accept.title: A Good Friend

4495-complete.name: Iverron
4495-complete.text: I'm so glad you found me, $N. How did you know I was here?
4495-complete.title: A Good Friend

456-accept.name: Conservator Ilthalaine
456-accept.text:
Greetings, $N.  I am Conservator Ilthalaine.  My purpose in Shadowglen is to ensure that the balance of nature is maintained.

The spring rains were particularly heavy this year, causing some of the forest's beasts to flourish while others suffered.

Unfortunately, the nightsaber and thistle boar populations grew too large.  Shadowglen can only produce so much food for the beasts.  Journey forth, young $c, and thin the boar and saber populations so that nature's harmony will be preserved.
456-accept.title: The Balance of Nature

457-accept.name: Conservator Ilthalaine
457-accept.text:
Thinning the younger population of creatures here in Shadowglen was a good start, $N, but there is still work to be done.

The resources of the forest will be depleted too quickly if the problem is not addressed.  Killing nature's beasts is a necessary evil for the good of all who share the land.  Venture into the forest and slay mangy nightsabers and thistle boars in the name of balance.
457-accept.title: The Balance of Nature

457-complete.name: Conservator Ilthalaine
457-complete.text: You have proven your dedication to nature well, $N.  A young $c like yourself has a promising future.
457-complete.title: The Balance of Nature

458-accept.name: Melithar Staghelm
458-accept.text:
Thank goodness you are here, $c. Strange news has traveled to me through the whisperings of the forest spirits.

The mysterious woodland protector, Tarindrella, has returned to Shadowglen. The dryad's presence has not been felt in the forests of Kalimdor in years. Something is surely amiss if she has journeyed back to this land.

Seek out Tarindrella and see what business she tends to in our grove. One of the Sentinels reported seeing her to the southwest of Aldrassil.
458-accept.title: The Woodland Protector

458-complete.name: Tarindrella
458-complete.text: I see you found me, young $r.  Melithar is a wise druid to have sent you. But you still have much to learn. I understand your kind enjoys books. Please take one of these to further your education.
458-complete.title: The Woodland Protector

459-accept.name: Tarindrella
459-accept.text:
Something evil is brewing in the forests of Teldrassil.  Look long the hills to where the peaceful furbolgs used to dwell.  They have deserted their homes and are amassing under the name of the Gnarlpine tribe.

Only the corruption of wicked Fel Moss could cause such a transformation.  The grells and grellkin have infested the area and are threatening the residents of Shadowglen.  

Engage these grells and grellkin, $N, and see if they are indeed caught under the enchantment of the wicked Fel Moss.
459-accept.title: The Woodland Protector

459-complete.name: Tarindrella
459-complete.text:
Your service to the creatures of Shadowglen is worthy of reward, $N.

You confirmed my fears, however.  If the grells have become tainted by the Fel Moss, one can only imagine what has become of the Gnarlpine tribe of furbolgs who once lived here.

Should you find yourself in Dolanaar, able $C, seek out the knowledgeable druid, Athridas Bearmantle.  He shares our concern for the well being of the forest.
459-complete.title: The Woodland Protector

459-progress.name: Tarindrella
459-progress.text: Satisfy my suspicions, $N.  Bring to me 8 Fel Moss.
459-progress.title: The Woodland Protector

475-accept.name: Athridas Bearmantle
475-accept.text:
A troubling breeze blows through the forest.

Gaerolas Talvethren serves as Great Warden to the hibernating Druids of the Talon in the Ban'ethil Barrow Den.  His duty as the chosen protector of the Sleeping is to ensure their safety so that their pact with Ysera remains fulfilled.

But word from Gaerolas is now delayed and I grow nervous.  Travel east to Starbreeze Village and bring back a report from Gaerolas so that I can put my worries to rest, knowing my dreaming brethren slumber safely.
475-accept.title: A Troubling Breeze

475-complete.name: Gaerolas Talvethren
475-complete.text: Thank the forest spirits you are here!  I knew Athridas would sense trouble and send help.
475-complete.title: A Troubling Breeze

476-accept.name: Gaerolas Talvethren
476-accept.text:
The Gnarlpine tribe has been corrupted!

The once peaceful furbolgs have turned against the protectors of the forest.  They ambushed me as I left for the Ban'ethil Barrow Den and proceeded to pillage Starbreeze Village.  Ursal the Mauler, their chieftain, is using the evil powers of the Fel Moss to drive them mad.

I am too wounded to return to Athridas to bring him this grave news.  The task is left to you, young $c.  We can only hope that the deranged Gnarlpines have not made it to Ban'ethil yet!
476-accept.title: Gnarlpine Corruption

476-complete.name: Athridas Bearmantle
476-complete.text: By the stars!  This is quite disturbing indeed!
476-complete.title: Gnarlpine Corruption

483-accept.name: Athridas Bearmantle
483-accept.text:
Gnarlpine invaders were seen ravaging the Ban'ethil Barrow Den to the west.

The slumbering druids will be trapped in the Emerald Dream for eternity, unaware of their fate, unless we help. The delicate hibernation ritual cannot be broken without the Relics of Wakening.

Journey to the Den and retrieve the Raven Claw Talisman, Black Feather Quill, Sapphire of Sky, and Rune of Nesting. The druids store them in sacred chests.  Return them to me and I will prepare the awakening ritual.
483-accept.title: The Relics of Wakening

487-accept.name: Moon Priestess Amara
487-accept.text:
The road to Darnassus must be kept safe.  Travelers heading from Dolanaar to Darnassus have been reporting ruthless attacks by corrupted furbolgs from the Gnarlpine tribe.

Important news and commerce travels to and from Darnassus by way of this road daily.  We cannot afford to have a $c band of heathens terrorizing people.

Take up arms in the name of the sacred forest, $c.  Their den lies somewhere below this vantage point.  Slay 6 of these Gnarlpine ambushers and report back to me.
487-accept.title: The Road to Darnassus

488-accept.name: Zenn Foulhoof
488-accept.text:
Eager for work, I see.  Lucky for you a day never goes by that I don't wish I had a fledgling $c to perform my bidding.

You see, $N, I can make you very happy and provide you with things you never dreamed of having.  But in order for that to happen you must bring me certain items.

My business in the forest often requires certain. . .reagents.  Fetch for me 3 Nightsaber Fangs, 3 Strigid Owl Feathers and 3 swatches of Webwood Spider Silk.

Let's keep this our little secret, $r.
488-accept.title: Zenn's Bidding

488-complete.name: Zenn Foulhoof
488-complete.text:
Ha ha!  Well, done indeed.

Who would have ever guessed that I, Zenn Foulhoof, would have a $r to do my bidding?  Certainly not me!  But so it goes... this beloved world of ours is full of surprises.

Three cheers for the naive and gullible!
488-complete.title: Zenn's Bidding

488-progress.name: Zenn Foulhoof
488-progress.text: Have you been a busy little bee, $N?  I've been waiting for you to bring me what I need.
488-progress.title: Zenn's Bidding

489-accept.name: Sentinel Kyra Starsong
489-accept.text:
The Council of the Forest has news that you aided Zenn Foulhoof. The satyr is an enemy of the forest. As a $r, you should know better than to defile the forest by killing Nature's creatures.

You must redeem yourself in the eyes of the Council if you wish to remain a friend of Teldrassil.

Teach Foulhoof a lesson and you shall be redeemed. Fel Cones are corrupted seeds that fall from the trees. They billow with green smoke.

Give some to Foulhoof. He'll think you have brought him a harmless snack.
489-accept.title: Seek Redemption!

489-complete.name: Zenn Foulhoof
489-complete.text: Ah, what a sweet $r!  I knew you would come in handy!
489-complete.title: Seek Redemption!

489-progress.name: Zenn Foulhoof
489-progress.text: What do you have for me, $N?  A lovely snack I presume?
489-progress.title: Seek Redemption!

65603-complete.name: Gakin the Darkbinder
65603-complete.text:
Not bad, $N. Your have bested the fiend, and your will remains unbroken.

Many a $c has believed themselves strong enough to bind a sayaad, only to become the demon's next meal instead. I am pleased to see you are not so foolish.

Watch closely, and I will teach you the invocation to call upon your newly bound incubus.
65603-complete.title: The Binding

65603-progress.name: Gakin the Darkbinder
65603-progress.text:
The incubus will try to lower your guard through beguilement and deception. The demon is adept at swaying the hearts of mortals.

Remember that anything it may offer you is false. To the demon, you are merely prey.
65603-progress.title: The Binding

743-accept.name: Ruul Eagletalon
743-accept.text:
Thank you for taking the time to speak to me, $N. I am Ruul, warrior and teacher.

You have obviously reached an age when you must prepare for your trials if you are to adventure much further out of Mulgore.

If you wish a test of your strength, start by seeking out the Windfury harpies to the southeast. They nestle along the mountain's edges away from the road.

They are one of our natural enemies here in Mulgore and will be a good gauge of your skill.
743-accept.title: Dangers of the Windfury

745-accept.name: Baine Bloodhoof
745-accept.text:
$N, there are many conflicts that wound this land. It is my hope that you will not bear witness to as many of them as I have. Yet there is one that I would ask you to seek out. It will give you some sense of how terrible, if left unchecked, even a small threat can be to the land.

Palemane gnolls have settled to the south of Bloodhoof and in a cave to the west. They disrespect our attempts to communicate with them, and they slay the wildlife of Mulgore unbridled.

Words are no longer the answer.
745-accept.title: Sharing the Land

745-complete.name: Baine Bloodhoof
745-complete.text: $N, it is good you've taken my task seriously. Respect of the land and its creatures is important. Death and life are a circle... a necessity. One cannot exist without the other. Take time to ponder this and do well to never forget it.
745-complete.title: Sharing the Land

746-accept.name: Baine Bloodhoof
746-accept.text:
There are dwarves preparing a dig site to the northwest.  They think secrets lie in the earth, and that is true, but hollowing and defiling the land is no way to earn its teachings.

Collect the dwarven tools of digging, smash them, and return to me with the dwarves' broken tools.

You can smash the tools at a forge.  You will find one in Thunder Bluff, but any forge -- even a forge at the dwarven camp -- will suffice.
746-accept.title: Dwarven Digging

747-accept.name: Grull Hawkwind
747-accept.text:
You have a promising air about you, and will prove yourself to the tribe. Perhaps someday soon you will be welcomed into the great city of Thunder Bluff. But before that can happen you must prove yourself to my father, Chief Hawkwind.

Up here on Red Cloud Mesa we pride ourselves on keen hunting skills. $R hunt out of necessity and for sport. Our supply of meats has run low and we require feathers for clothing. Hunt the nearby plainstriders and prove yourself by resupplying the village.
747-accept.title: The Hunt Begins

747-complete.name: Grull Hawkwind
747-complete.text: The $r of Narache thank you, $N. You show much promise.
747-complete.title: The Hunt Begins

747-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
747-progress.text: Providing meat and feathers for the tribe is the first step in proving yourself as a $c before the Chief.
747-progress.title: The Hunt Begins

750-accept.name: Grull Hawkwind
750-accept.text:
A $r skilled in the ways of the hunt knows that his prey is not for mere trophy. The beasts of the plains provide us with a means of survival. You will make quite an impression on the elders if you can bring back some highly valued Mountain Cougar Pelts. You can find the beasts lurking in the hills to the south.

Our children need clothing and our tents need mending.
750-accept.title: The Hunt Continues

750-complete.name: Grull Hawkwind
750-complete.text: The $r of Narache thank you for these provisions, $N. With your skill in the ways of the hunt you will surely be revered in Thunder Bluff someday.
750-complete.title: The Hunt Continues

750-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
750-progress.text: If you can provide pelts for the tribe I will pass word along to my father, Chief Hawkwind, of your generous deeds.
750-progress.title: The Hunt Continues

752-accept.name: Chief Hawkwind
752-accept.text:
All members of the tribe share in the harmony of life. We live together and work together.

Our commitment to one another carries with it a high degree of responsibility. I ask of you now a humble task.

My mother set out this morning to fetch water from the well to the southeast of Narache. It has been quite some time now. Perhaps you could check on her for me while I attend to tribal matters here?
752-accept.title: A Humble Task

752-complete.name: Greatmother Hawkwind
752-complete.text: You traveled all this way just to help an old woman? My my, aren't you a keeper? Here, take one of these training manuals with you, so you may learn how to contribute to the community.
752-complete.title: A Humble Task

753-accept.name: Greatmother Hawkwind
753-accept.text:
I have traveled many paths through life and these old legs lack the vigor they once had. I can still perform my duties to the tribe. Sometimes it just takes an old woman a little longer to do the task.

But you look like an eager $c. Let's put some of that youthful vitality to the test. Take a water pitcher from the well and bring it to my son, the Chief, in Camp Narache.

Remember that even the most humble task can gain the recognition of elders.
753-accept.title: A Humble Task

753-complete.name: Chief Hawkwind
753-complete.text:
You carried this pitcher back at the Greatmother's bidding, I see.

Your willingness to help others and provide for the $r of Camp Narache leads me to believe you would make the tribe proud in Thunder Bluff someday.
753-complete.title: A Humble Task

753-progress.name: Chief Hawkwind
753-progress.text: You look as though you have returned from the plains. Do you have any word from Greatmother Hawkwind?
753-progress.title: A Humble Task

755-accept.name: Chief Hawkwind
755-accept.text:
Your willingness to perform a humble task for the $r of Narache and your eagerness to learn are noble traits, $N. I believe one day you will be heralded in Thunder Bluff as a $c of greatness.

Before that you must embark on the Rites of the Earthmother, of which there are three.

The first test is the Rite of Strength. Travel to Seer Graytongue and tell him Chief Hawkwind has sent you.

You will find the seer's abode directly to the south of Camp Narache, tucked away in the hills.
755-accept.title: Rites of the Earthmother

755-complete.name: Seer Graytongue
755-complete.text: Chief Hawkwind sent you? Embarking on the Rites of the Earthmother is no small task...
755-complete.title: Rites of the Earthmother

757-accept.name: Seer Graytongue
757-accept.text:
The Rites of the Earthmother are the steps a young $r needs to take to gain respect in Thunder Bluff.

First you must pass the Rite of Strength. In this test you must prove your bravery by slaying enemies of the tribe.

Bristlebacks of Brambleblade Ravine to the east are encroaching on our tribal lands. They ambush our hunting parties and steal from the village by dark.

Show your valor by slaying these villains and return to the Chief in Camp Narache with their belts as proof of your deeds.
757-accept.title: Rite of Strength

757-complete.name: Chief Hawkwind
757-complete.text: You have passed the first test of the Rites of the Earthmother. The tribe will be proud.
757-complete.title: Rite of Strength

757-progress.name: Chief Hawkwind
757-progress.text: Have you completed the Rite of Strength, $N? I require proof of your valor against the enemy of our tribe, the Bristlebacks.
757-progress.title: Rite of Strength

763-accept.name: Chief Hawkwind
763-accept.text:
For you to continue with the Rites of the Earthmother you must pass two more tests. It is time for you to broaden your experience, $N.

Travel to Bloodhoof Village and seek out the Chief, Baine Bloodhoof, son of Cairne. There you may continue your journey and earn the acceptance of the elders of Thunder Bluff.

Take this totem to Baine. He will recognize my carvings and help you on your path.

Follow the road out of Camp Narache and travel with haste. Do not stray or you will lose your way.
763-accept.title: Rites of the Earthmother

763-complete.name: Baine Bloodhoof
763-complete.text: Word from my good friend, Chief Hawkwind! Ah, I can see by his carvings you are of a special breed.
763-complete.title: Rites of the Earthmother

763-progress.name: Baine Bloodhoof
763-progress.text: What brings you to my village, $c?
763-progress.title: Rites of the Earthmother

767-accept.name: Baine Bloodhoof
767-accept.text:
The Rite of Vision, one of the Rites of the Earthmother, will help guide you toward earning the respect of the elders of Thunder Bluff.

Our people have learned that the land is our most holy provider. In order to take part in the ritualistic vision, you must speak with the spiritual leader of the village, Zarlman Two-Moons.
767-accept.title: Rite of Vision

767-complete.name: Zarlman Two-Moons
767-complete.text: I sensed you would be coming to me, $c. I can always recognize one who is trying to pass the Rites of the Earthmother.
767-complete.title: Rite of Vision

771-accept.name: Zarlman Two-Moons
771-accept.text:
In order to pass through the Rite of Vision, you must gather the reagents needed to make the Water of the Seers.

I will need well stones, which can be found around the water wells in Mulgore. With those I will combine Ambercorn, which fall beneath the mighty trees in our land.

These reagents contain magical elements, and when brewed and consumed before the tribal fire, will cause you to encounter a vision. Follow it, and it will lead you to the next step of this holy quest.
771-accept.title: Rite of Vision

771-complete.name: Zarlman Two-Moons
771-complete.text: I see you have learned to gather from our sacred land, $N. It will take but a moment for me to brew the Water of the Seers.
771-complete.title: Rite of Vision

771-progress.name: Zarlman Two-Moons
771-progress.text: Once you have gathered enough well stones from around the water wells and Ambercorn from beneath the trees, I will prepare the Water of the Seers for you.
771-progress.title: Rite of Vision

772-accept.name: Zarlman Two-Moons
772-accept.text:
I now present you with the Water of the Seers.

When you are ready, consume the waters near the tribal fire. Once you have ingested the holy waters, it will take a few moments before the vision materializes before the fire.

At that point, it is up to you to follow it to your destiny....
772-accept.title: Rite of Vision

772-complete.name: Seer Wiserunner
772-complete.text: Be not afraid, $N. You have successfully passed the Rite of Vision.
772-complete.title: Rite of Vision

780-accept.name: Grull Hawkwind
780-accept.text:
The Battleboars of Brambleblade Ravine to the east are encroaching on our tribal hunting grounds. They are trained to be malicious by the Bristleback Quilboars with whom we are at war.

Go and slay the vile creatures and bring back some snouts and flanks so that we can make stew for our young.
780-accept.title: The Battleboars

780-complete.name: Grull Hawkwind
780-complete.text: Most excellent. These ingredients will make a fine stew and the loss of those boars should be a fair lesson to those vile Bristlebacks.
780-complete.title: The Battleboars

780-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
780-progress.text: The aggression of the Battleboars is increasing. Have you sent them a clear message and brought back some snouts and flanks yet?
780-progress.title: The Battleboars

863-complete.name: Sputtervalve
863-complete.text:
Hopefully we'll be able to get something of value from the wrecked shredder prototype... my time's running out! I'll dispatch a salvage team to Wizzlecrank's location on the double.

Oh, let me give you something for your trouble, too.
863-complete.title: The Escape

87288-progress.name: Aldia
87288-progress.text: It is good to see you again! Are you here to trade?
87288-progress.title: Soft Saber Pelts

896-complete.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
896-complete.text:
Look at the size of that thing, $N! We're going to be rich! Let's see, according to the rates I've seen on gems going into Undermine, I should be able to figure out your cut--fifty percent, don't worry!

Now let's see... I think this should do about right. Pleasure doing business with you, $N.
896-complete.title: Miner's Fortune

896-progress.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
896-progress.text: If only we knew which one of the miners had found the emerald, it'd be a walk in the park...
896-progress.title: Miner's Fortune

916-accept.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
916-accept.text:
I came to Shadowglen to observe the webwood spiders that dwell in the Shadowthread Cave.  They are cousin to a much smaller variety of spider; I believe the world tree has had a profound effect on them, and I would like specimens to study to confirm this.

First, I would like some of their venom.  Gather Webwood venom sacs from the spiders in and around the Shadowthread Cave, to the north.  I can then examine them for similarities with their smaller cousin's venom.
916-accept.title: Webwood Venom

916-complete.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
916-complete.text: Thank you, $N.  When I return to Darnassus I will compare the venom within these sacs with the venom of other spiders.  It is my belief that it will have properties linked to the recent growth of our new world tree.
916-complete.title: Webwood Venom

916-progress.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
916-progress.text: Did you gather the venom sacs, $N?
916-progress.title: Webwood Venom

917-accept.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
917-accept.text:
Now that I have the spiders' venom, I'd like some live specimens to study.  Unfortunately, capturing a living, giant spider is more than I can ask of you, young $c.  And a giant spider is more than I could handle myself!

But if you can find an unhatched egg, then delivering specimens will be much easier, and I can then arrange for the unhatched spiders to be contained.

There must be a nest deep in the Shadowthread Cave.  Please, search for an egg in the nest and return it to me.
917-accept.title: Webwood Egg

917-complete.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
917-complete.text: Ah, very good.  I will have this egg and the venom transported to Darnassus, then return there when my studies are done here.  I expect to find out a great deal from these specimens, $N.  You have been a great help to me.
917-complete.title: Webwood Egg

917-progress.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
917-progress.text: Have you been inside the Shadowthread Cave, $N?  Did you find a spider egg?
917-progress.title: Webwood Egg

918-accept.name: Denalan
918-accept.text:
The timberlings of Teldrassil are elementals of nature.  In some ways they reflect the natural order of plants and animals on our great tree.

So it is disturbing to see how angry the timberlings have become.

I believe it has something to do with the soil.  I have been working on different methods of nurturing plants and would like to try them on timberling seeds.  Please, can you gather seeds from timberlings around Lake Al'Ameth and bring them to me?
918-accept.title: Timberling Seeds

918-complete.name: Denalan
918-complete.text:
You got them.  This is good!

I will plant these seeds in special soil I have prepared.  I believe the seeds will sprout into timberlings who are much more docile.  Perhaps later you can see the results!
918-complete.title: Timberling Seeds

918-progress.name: Denalan
918-progress.text: Do you have the seeds?  I am eager to plant them.
918-progress.title: Timberling Seeds

919-accept.name: Denalan
919-accept.text:
Small timberlings are sprouting around the waters of Lake Al'Ameth.  I'm afraid these sprouts are beyond help -- we should try to clear them from the land before they grow large enough to cause trouble.

When you're wandering the lake, if you see any timberling sprouts please take them.  Help keep our land clean!
919-accept.title: Timberling Sprouts

919-complete.name: Denalan
919-complete.text:
That's a lot!  I'm afraid they're spreading at a dangerous rate.  I hope I can solve the riddle of what is tainting them.

Thank you for your help, $N.  The land is a cleaner place from your efforts.
919-complete.title: Timberling Sprouts

919-progress.name: Denalan
919-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Have you found any sprouts near the waters?
919-progress.title: Timberling Sprouts

920-accept.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
920-accept.text:
$N, is it? I heard that Tenaron has been asking for you. You'll find him in the highest room atop Aldrassil.

We may live long lives, but it's best you not keep him waiting too long.
920-accept.title: Tenaron's Summons

920-complete.name: Tenaron Stormgrip
920-complete.text: Ah, $N. I was hoping you'd be prompt in answering my summons. I have an important task that I would like you to perform.
920-complete.title: Tenaron's Summons

921-accept.name: Tenaron Stormgrip
921-accept.text:
It is time for you to set out to seek your destiny, $N. But before you are ready to set out into the world beyond our enchanted forests, there is much you must learn about our recent history.

Much has changed with our people since the Battle of Mount Hyjal. Nordrassil lies a pale shadow of what it once was, its power used to defeat Archimonde and drive back the Burning Legion...

There is a task you must perform. Go to the moonwell north of Aldrassil and return me a phial of its water.
921-accept.title: Crown of the Earth

921-complete.name: Tenaron Stormgrip
921-complete.text: So you have heard the first part of the aftermath of the Battle of Mount Hyjal. There is much more to be told and the task you have begun here will continue through the rest of your journey through Teldrassil and into Darnassus.
921-complete.title: Crown of the Earth

921-progress.name: Tenaron Stormgrip
921-progress.text:
The moonwells hold the waters of the Well of Eternity, the ancient source of magic that has wrought so many horrors upon our world.

The druids take advantage of its properties, and the Sentinels revere the wells as shrines to Elune, but sorcery is forbidden to all.
921-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

922-accept.name: Denalan
922-accept.text:
$N, can you take one of the seeds you brought me to my friend, Rellian Greenspyre?  He is a druid in Darnassus, and when last we spoke he revealed his interest in my work with the Timberlings.  He had some ideas himself, and he will appreciate a specimen seed to work with.

Thank you, $N.  You have been a great help to me.  I hope that, some day, you will see the fruit of my labors.

You will usually find Rellian walking the pathways of the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus.
922-accept.title: Rellian Greenspyre

928-accept.name: Tenaron Stormgrip
928-accept.text:
While there is more I could speak to you of the moonwells and of Teldrassil, I must send you along. Corithras Moonrage will be expecting you. I have poured the phial of water you brought to me into this vessel to bring to him.

Seek out Corithras. You will find him at the moonwell in Dolanaar. Follow the road south from Aldrassil out of Shadowglen, and continue to follow the cobblestones as the road turns west.

Mind you stay on the road though, $N. There are dangerous beasts in the forests of late.
928-accept.title: Crown of the Earth

928-complete.name: Corithras Moonrage
928-complete.text:
Ah, I see. You were sent by Tenaron. Well then, it would seem we have much to talk about, much to do, and little time to do it in.

I think we'd best get started.
928-complete.title: Crown of the Earth

928-progress.name: Corithras Moonrage
928-progress.text: Greetings, $c. For what purpose do I owe the pleasure of our meeting?
928-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

929-accept.name: Corithras Moonrage
929-accept.text:
First, let me tell you more of the task you must complete. The druids in Darnassus use the water of the moonwells of Teldrassil, and their moonwell must be replenished from time to time. Using these specially crafted phials, you can collect the water of the moonwells.

Take this vessel to the moonwell outside of Starbreeze Village to the east, and fill it with some of its waters, then return to me. When you have completed your task, I shall continue the story where Tenaron left off...
929-accept.title: Crown of the Earth

929-complete.name: Corithras Moonrage
929-complete.text:
After the Battle of Mount Hyjal, we were without direction. Nordrassil smoked from the fire it unleashed, and our immortality--the very essence of our beings!--was lost.

It was in this trying time that the Betrayer was freed from his prison, and Shan'do Stormrage disappeared. A dark time for all.
929-complete.title: Crown of the Earth

929-progress.name: Corithras Moonrage
929-progress.text: Hello again, $N. Have you completed your task?
929-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

932-accept.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
932-accept.text:
I must warn you, $N, this matter must stay between us. The satyr are enough of an embarrassment to us already, and this one is much too close to home.

He is called Lord Melenas. He resides in the nearby cave of Fel Rock where he has gathered a large group of grell warriors. His heart is black as night, and he plots something most foul.

You must find him within his nearby cave just to the north of here, and bring me his head.
932-accept.title: Twisted Hatred

933-accept.name: Corithras Moonrage
933-accept.text:
There is another moonwell southeast of the entrance to Darnassus, on the shores of the Pools of Arlithrien. The Sentinels are having problems patrolling the area because of attacks and the growing ill-temperedness of the Gnarlpine furbolgs.

Be wary as you seek out the well, and keep your weapons close at hand.
933-accept.title: Crown of the Earth

96605-progress.name: Kaga Wildhoof

997-accept.name: Syral Bladeleaf
997-accept.text:
Are you heading to the south?  To Lake Al'Ameth?  If so, then I have a task I might ask of you...

My colleague Denalan has a camp along the eastern end of the lake, where he is studying and experimenting on the plant life of Teldrassil.  He requested a package of rare earths from Darnassus and it was late, only recently arriving here in Dolanaar.

Can you take the package to him?
997-accept.title: Denalan's Earth

997-complete.name: Denalan
997-complete.text:
Ah, it's here!  I have waited for this rare earth for quite some time.  I hope it's still fresh...

Thank you for bringing it to me, $N.  You are a $r who is generous with his time.
997-complete.title: Denalan's Earth
